title: claude.ai Project spec
description: The one claude.ai Project of this repo, named after it: iac/specs/claude/project.json. A Project is created and edited only in the claude.ai UI (https://claude.ai/code), so the spec is applied by hand and verified by hand; the audit (scripts/audit_repo.py, rule claude-project) checks that the file exists, that the name is the repo's, and that every routine spec's hearth_channel_id is this id. The claude-project rule in stevenuray/repo-standards standards.md.

id.description: The Project's channel id, the one every routine spec names in hearth_channel_id and that RemoteTrigger accepts. It is the last path segment of the Project's URL, https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_...

name.description: The Project's name in the claude.ai UI: the repo's name (the last segment of the origin URL without .git), exactly.

description.description: Repo-side note on what the Project holds: the repo's routines and their run threads, the ad hoc cloud sessions started for it, any knowledge uploaded by hand.

verified_on.description: The day a human last opened the Project in the UI and found its name and settings equal to this spec (ISO 8601 date), or null until that has happened.
